step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is an outstanding registration number for the issue:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 4.

If no, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign a registration number as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Click Update .

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if a violation is imposed for the case:

ul.li: If no, go to step 5.
If yes, refer to Modifying or rescinding a violation to rescind the violation, then go to step 5. Modifying or rescinding a violation

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select D - No .
Click Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
BPC: Select the BPC of the claim being amended.

Work item: Select the appropriate option:
If the claim is blocked or archived, select 91 - Overpayment .
If the claim is active or non-blocked, select 92 - Purge and Recreate .
If it is an MPS claim or a claim with a BPC within the current week minus 150 or more, select 93 - Manual Pay System .

Work type: Select the appropriate option:
If the Work item is 91 , select 6 - Change from misrepresentation to non-misrepresentation on blocked or history claim .
If the Work item is 92 , select 21 - Change from misrepresentation to non-misrepresentation on an active claim .
If the Work item is 93 , select 30 - New information on a manual pay claim .
Earnings to be allocated: Complete this section if applicable. Note
Remarks line 1: Type “Change case to non-misrepresentation — [type of the original transaction, i.e. MM06] — [date].”

Remarks line 2: Select the appropriate option:
If the decision is rescinding a misrepresentation only, type “Change OP coding to non-misrepresentation [non-misrepresentation OP codes].”
If a penalty and a violation are imposed or if only a penalty is imposed, type “Rescind P [penalty amount in dollars] and change OP coding to [non-misrepresentation OP codes].”
If only a violation (warning, unclassified or classified) is imposed, type “Change OP coding to [non-misrepresentation OP codes]. VLN rescinded by DM.”

Remarks line 3 : If the decision also includes a change to the OP (e.g. amending an allocation, rescinding a disqualification or terminating a disentitlement) include the following:
For the rescinding of a disqualification, type “Rescind disqualification-[code] from w/c [XXXX] to [XXXX].”
For the rescinding of a disentitlement, type “Rescind disentitlement-[code] from w/c [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X].”
For the termination of a disentitlement, type “Terminate disentitlement [code] from w/c [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X].”
For the amendment of an allocation, type “Amend allocation [code] [amount] from w/c [XXXX] to [XXXX].”
For other cases, leave the field blank.
Remarks line 4: Leave the field blank.
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.

Detection: Select the appropriate option:
If it is an administrative review decision, select 21 - Request for Reconsideration / ≤ w/c 1867 appeal .
If it is not an administrative review decision, select the detection code used on the initial input.

Infraction: Select the appropriate option:
If it is an administrative review decision, select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
If it is not an administrative review decision, select the non-fraud equivalent of the code used on the initial input. code

Message: Select the appropriate option:
Select 6 - Earnings other than declared .
Select 8 - Your earnings were not deducted .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Click Update .

step.cmd: Click the Outstanding Registrations link to transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Click Modify .

Complete the appropriate registration section as follows:
Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Click Update .

step.cmd: Return to the originating task to send the letter and to complete the WI.
